text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Shion. I commend thee for thy previous 
tribute.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Chuckle. You must be referring to the 
apples you shared with me. They certainly 
were of exceptional quality.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Not only the flavor, but the aroma is rich 
and mellow as well—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Furthermore, its color, luster, 
and sweetness... visually, it has 
delighted this King. You have done well.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Umm, I'm glad it suits your taste! To be 
honest though... it was a bit unexpected.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
To think someone could be so genuinely 
happy... with something ordinary, like an 
apple...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
How strange. It is precisely because one 
stands at the heights that one's sight is 
keen—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Ah, come to think of it, my elder sister 
took a liking to it as well. She said she 
sent a return gift to your family home.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Huh? U-Um, did I ever tell you my parents' 
address...?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
My, my, so the King leaves everything to 
her big sister... How adorable.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Ho ho ho, I took care of everything with 
my own hands. Arranging the thank-you 
gifts, turning them into juice—yes, all of 
it.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(These people really are...\nnot normal... 
It's scary...)
